corrections.from: *Natural observation*: In primary adrenal failure "the cortisol will not rise dur
corrections.finding: A narrator doer-verb left in a written item: 'a dobutamine stress echo shows wall segments failing to move'. Re-said by what is ('finds').

fixed.text: A provocative probe sounds a latent departure ahead: a cosyntropin probe leaves cortisol flat in primary adrenal failure, a sodium-current-blocking drug reveals a Type 1 Brugada pattern in a heart that shows an ordinary trace at rest, a dobutamine stress echo finds wall segments failing to move at an ischaemic heart, a dexamethasone probe leaves an autonomously acting adrenal axis unsuppressed, a naloxone challenge brings on withdrawal at a carried dependence, edrophonium briefly restores strength in myasthenia gravis, and a glucose-shaped tracer gathers at the cells changing fastest.
fixed.from: *Natural observation*: In primary adrenal failure "the cortisol will not rise dur

corrections.from: *Natural observation*: Thalidomide's two hands interconvert: the paper gives, fro
corrections.finding: A narrator doer-verb and a floating negation left in a written item: 'the other shows no such activity'. Re-said as is-or-is-not by what is: 'the other is-not'.

fixed.text: Thalidomide's two hands interconvert, a racemization half-life about twelve hours in buffer and about one hour in serum; one single hand is teratogenic and the other is-not despite ready interconversion in the body; stirring a slight excess of one hand enriches it to as much as 98%, and the even mixture dissolves in water at about a fifth of each single hand's solubility.
fixed.from: *Natural observation*: Thalidomide's two hands interconvert: the paper gives, fro

corrections.from: ### Amyloid cleared, decline slowed by a quarter
corrections.finding: Placed as an exploring at a 5.1 sentence ('a neurodegeneration assignments past fields' own mitochondrial observations') that is a loose entry in the nye-list of claims that do NOT stand ('Observed with that same binary and not standing here'). The sentence is not the subject this observing meets, so it belongs at the back as a droplet, its place in the contents not yet clear.

fixed.text: Clearing brain amyloid in early Alzheimer's disease slowed the worsening of a dementia rating over eighteen months by about a quarter, with brain amyloid falling and with infusion reactions and amyloid-related imaging abnormalities in a portion of those on the drug; amyloid pathology rises from about a tenth of people at age fifty to near a half at ninety; and many older people carry abundant plaques and tangles with intact cognition, loss of synapses tracking cognitive decline more closely than plaques do.
fixed.from: ### Amyloid cleared, decline slowed by a quarter

corrections.from: ### Amyloid-β entrapping microbes, and a 40 hertz flicker
corrections.finding: Placed as an exploring at a 5.1 sentence ('a neurodegeneration assignments past fields' own mitochondrial observations') that is a loose entry in the nye-list of claims that do NOT stand ('Observed with that same binary and not standing here'). The sentence is not the subject this observing meets, so it belongs at the back as a droplet, its place in the contents not yet clear.

fixed.text: Amyloid-β protects against fungal and bacterial infection, its soluble oligomers binding microbial cell-wall carbohydrates and its fibrils agglutinating and entrapping the microbes, and a brain infection seeds and accelerates amyloid-β deposition that sits with the bacteria; driving fast-spiking interneurons or a light flickering at forty hertz lowers amyloid-β in some brain regions with microglia changing form, and a later work finds no reliable lowering of amyloid load across its models.
fixed.from: ### Amyloid-β entrapping microbes, and a 40 hertz flicker

corrections.from: ### A shingles vaccine and fewer dementia diagnoses
corrections.finding: Placed as an exploring at a 5.1 sentence ('a neurodegeneration assignments past fields' own mitochondrial observations') that is a loose entry in the nye-list of claims that do NOT stand ('Observed with that same binary and not standing here'). The sentence is not the subject this observing meets, so it belongs at the back as a droplet, its place in the contents not yet clear.

fixed.text: Eligibility for a shingles vaccine set by date of birth, with uptake rising from near nothing to about a half across the cut-off, went with a fall of about a fifth in new dementia diagnoses over seven years, stronger among women, and a follow-up with the same design finds fewer diagnoses of mild cognitive impairment and fewer deaths from dementia.
fixed.from: ### A shingles vaccine and fewer dementia diagnoses

corrections.from: ### Semaglutide at weight, alcohol and cigarettes
corrections.finding: Placed as an exploring at 1.2's sentence 'an intervention removing a thing a restoration was waiting on, a restoring a body's own'. The semaglutide observing is the opposite case: the gains depend on continued dosing and revert when it stops, so the sentence is not the subject it meets. It belongs at the back as a droplet.

fixed.text: A weekly GLP-1 analogue beside lifestyle change lowered body weight by about a seventh against a fortieth on placebo, and lowered the alcohol drunk and cigarettes smoked; a year after the drug stopped about two thirds of the weight loss had returned and the cardiometabolic gains reverted toward their starting values.
fixed.from: ### Semaglutide at weight, alcohol and cigarettes

corrections.from: ### Plants made still by anaesthetics, and a lag in waking
corrections.finding: Placed as an exploring at 4.1's interior-reaching sentence ('Something going inward, and an outward instrument unable to reach it, which is why unresponsiveness stands in place of a state and selves report experience from under it'). That sentence is about anaesthesia's unresponsiveness/experience split; the plant-stilling, induction/emergence hysteresis and pressure-reversal observing is about anaesthetic mechanism, not that subject. It belongs at the back as a droplet.

fixed.text: Mimosa leaves, pea tendrils, Venus flytraps and sundew traps lose their autonomous and touch-induced movements under anaesthetics and recover within minutes, the flytrap's loss coming from blocked action potentials; induction of anaesthesia and emergence from it follow different concentrations, the half-effect of induction above two and a half times that of emergence for one agent; and reversal of anaesthesia by high pressure appears in some species and conditions alone.
fixed.from: ### Plants made still by anaesthetics, and a lag in waking

corrections.finding: Marked leaving as held at 3.1, but the section carries two observings. The second (single cells, phenotypic switching, biphasic killing, non-inherited, progeny sensitive) is indeed held at 3.1. The first (Allison: certain metabolic stimuli enabling aminoglycosides to kill dormant persisters) is a value the living file does not hold, and 3.1/3.69's framing is the opposite move (letting carry age, not driving uptake to kill). It is a value lost; kept as a droplet with its measures.

fixed.text: Certain metabolic stimuli, glucose and pyruvate among them, enable aminoglycosides to kill dormant persisters of Escherichia coli and of Staphylococcus aureus, an effect specific to aminoglycosides that proceeds without growth resumption, holds with and without air, treats biofilms of both bacteria, and improves treatment of a chronic urinary tract infection in a mouse model.
